name: countdown
title: Countdown
description: The time left until something, in days, hours, minutes and seconds.
use: A launch, the end of a sale, the start of an event or a reservation that expires: the time left, as figures over small labels. The root is a <time> whose datetime holds the same time left as a duration, such as P2DT14H5M9S. Without a script it is the time left when the page was made; a script may tick it, and a figure may be an odometer so its digits roll. It is never a live region: a screen reader reads it when the reader comes to it, not every second.

instead.when: It is when things happened, in order, not the time left
It is one number that changes, not a time
It is a task that completes, with an amount done

platform.feature: Alternative text for generated content, so the colons between units are not read: content: ':' / ''
platform.fallback: A screen reader may read the colons

classes.name: countdown
classes.description: The units in equal columns, as wide as the widest, with a colon in the middle of each gap. On a <time> whose datetime is the time left as a duration

classes.name: countdown-tiles
classes.description: Each figure in a small raised sheet, 2em square, with the label under it and no colons

classes.name: countdown-inline
classes.description: The units on one baseline, each label after its figure, at the size of the sentence around it: the figures in strong ink, the labels quiet

classes.name: countdown-unit
classes.description: One unit: its figure and its label

classes.name: countdown-value
classes.description: The figure, in tabular numerals. It may hold an odometer

classes.name: countdown-label
classes.description: What the unit counts, small and quiet: days, hours, minutes, seconds

states.name: ended
states.description: Time is up: the figures turn quiet and tiles sink to a flat well

properties.name: --countdown-size
properties.description: Size of the figures; tiles are twice as tall. The inline countdown takes the size of its sentence instead

properties.name: --countdown-gap
properties.description: Space between units, where the colons stand

example: 02 days 14 hours 05 minutes
